title: Flow Selection Live Preview
description: Fix flow area-select so preselected nodes and marquee overlay are live-previewed during drag (dag paint chrome + label overlay).
summary: Fixed flow group-select preview showing old selection with emphasized hover chrome instead of puzzle-2d-style secondary highlight. DagHost interaction chrome now distinguishes highlighted (preselect removed) from hovered: nodes, handles, and edges use selection_exit theme colors. Flow label overlay uses secondary token for highlightedIds.
